title: Pontotoc Food Depot lists Nov. 21 pickup and a separate December sign-up
excerpt: The depot’s regular schedule puts pickup and new applications on different Saturdays. A separate pantry on Highway 15 serves Pontotoc County residents on weekdays.

sources.title: Hunger Coalition’s Pontotoc pantry locations, hours and phones
Pontotoc Chamber guide to monthly Food Depot registration

facts.statement: Saturday, Nov. 21, is the November pickup date under the Churches United Food Depot’s regular third-Saturday schedule in Pontotoc. The Hunger Coalition of Northeast Mississippi lists hours of 8 to 10 a.m. at 24 S. Liberty St. Anyone making a trip can confirm arrangements with the depot at 662-419-3673.
facts.evidence: Coalition partner entry names depot, location, phone and third Saturday 8–10; Nov. 21 is third Saturday.
facts.date_context: The third Saturday of November 2026 is November 21. The next first Saturday is December 5. Times are regular posted hours.
facts.identities: Churches United Food Depot of Pontotoc County, Hunger Coalition of Northeast Mississippi, and Pontotoc Baptist Association Food Pantry.

facts.statement: People seeking to sign up for monthly food assistance have a separate date. The depot takes applications from 8 to 10 a.m. on the first Saturday of each month, which next falls on Dec. 5. The Chamber places the registration office at the corner of Marion and Liberty streets.
facts.evidence: Both sources distinguish first-Saturday application from distribution; Chamber identifies office intersection. Calendar checked.
facts.date_context: The third Saturday of November 2026 is November 21. The next first Saturday is December 5. Times are regular posted hours.
facts.identities: Churches United Food Depot of Pontotoc County, Hunger Coalition of Northeast Mississippi, and Pontotoc Baptist Association Food Pantry.

facts.statement: For people seeking food during the week, the Pontotoc Baptist Association Food Pantry is a separate operation at 254 Highway 15 North. The Hunger Coalition lists its regular Tuesday and Thursday hours as 9 to 11 a.m. With Thanksgiving falling on a Thursday, call the pantry at 662-489-1251 to check holiday hours before visiting.

paragraphs.text: Saturday, Nov. 21, is the November pickup date under the Churches United Food Depot’s regular third-Saturday schedule in Pontotoc. The Hunger Coalition of Northeast Mississippi lists hours of 8 to 10 a.m. at 24 S. Liberty St. Anyone making a trip can confirm arrangements with the depot at 662-419-3673.

People seeking to sign up for monthly food assistance have a separate date. The depot takes applications from 8 to 10 a.m. on the first Saturday of each month, which next falls on Dec. 5. The Chamber places the registration office at the corner of Marion and Liberty streets.

For people seeking food during the week, the Pontotoc Baptist Association Food Pantry is a separate operation at 254 Highway 15 North. The Hunger Coalition lists its regular Tuesday and Thursday hours as 9 to 11 a.m. With Thanksgiving falling on a Thursday, call the pantry at 662-489-1251 to check holiday hours before visiting.
